events.title: First Documented Phishing Attack
events.event: AOL (America Online) users ko 'AOL Billing' naam se fake messages mile. Password aur credit card maanga gaya. Hacker 'Da Chronic' ne AOL ka algorithm reverse engineer kiya aur auto-generate fake accounts banaye.
events.impact: Pehla documented phishing. Term 'phishing' yahin se popular hua (fishing analogy se).
events.lesson: Trust + urgency ka combo = universal phishing recipe. Ye aaj tak kaam karta hai.

events.title: Phishing Term Popularized
events.event: AOL chat rooms me 'fishing' term use hone laga. Hacker groups (AOHell tool) se mass phishing easy ho gayi. Credit card + password combos 'carding' forums pe bikne lage.
events.impact: Organized phishing economy shuru. Underground forums me credentials currency ban gayi.
events.lesson: Attackers har naye communication medium ko target karte hain — chat rooms, emails, SMS, social media.

events.title: First Reported Phishing of Banks
events.event: Online banking shuru hui. Attackers ne fake bank pages banaye jo asli jaisi dikhti. Customers credentials daalte — accounts drain. E-gold (digital currency) bhi target hua.
events.impact: Financial sector me phishing ka pehla serious wave.
events.lesson: Jab bhi paisa online aata hai, attackers ready hote hain.

events.title: eBay + PayPal Mass Phishing Wave
events.event: Massive phishing emails eBay aur PayPal users ko gaye. 'Account suspended' ka darr, 'verify now' link. Hazaaron accounts compromise. Attackers Russia + Eastern Europe se operate kar rahe the.
events.impact: Pehla widespread brand impersonation. Anti-Phishing Working Group (APWG) 2003 me form hui.
events.lesson: Brand trust sabse zyada valuable hai — attackers usko copy karte hain.

events.title: Phishing Kit Industry Born
events.event: Rock Phish gang ne 'phishing kits' bechi — ready-to-use fake websites + email templates. Non-technical log bhi phishing kar sakte. Kits $50-$500 me available thi. Fast-Flux DNS se hosting hide karti.
events.impact: Phishing barrier-to-entry collapse. Attackers exponentially badhe.
events.lesson: As-a-Service model cybercrime ko democratize karta hai.

events.title: US Banks Warned About Phishing
events.event: Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC) ne banks ko warning issue ki — phishing ke against 2FA implement karo. Result: banks ne SMS OTP, hardware tokens shuru kiye.
events.impact: 2FA mainstream hua banking me. Attackers ne social engineering se 2FA bypass karna shuru kiya.
events.lesson: Regulation + tech = arms race. Har defense ke against attacker naya tareeka dhundta hai.

events.title: First Major DNS Hijacking (Pharming)
events.event: Mexican bank Banca de los Andes ka DNS server hack hua. Customers 'banco.com' type karte the, URL bilkul sahi dikhta tha — par nakli site khulti thi. Attacker ne credentials capture kiye. Loss: $100k+.
events.impact: Pharming (DNS + Phishing) ka pehla documented case. Companies ne DNSSEC implement karna shuru kiya.
events.lesson: URL dekhna kaafi nahi — DNS-level attacks URL ko bhi bharosa nahi karne dete.

events.title: Mobile Phishing Starts
events.event: Mobile phones common hue. First SMS phishing attacks aaye (later 'Smishing' term aaya). Fake bank alerts, lottery, delivery messages. Mobile browsers me URL verify karna mushkil tha.
events.impact: New attack channel. Mobile me security awareness kam thi.
events.lesson: Naya channel = naya attack vector. Attackers sab jagah adapt karte.

events.title: First Major Social Media Phishing
events.event: Facebook, Twitter, MySpace pe fake login pages. 'Your friend tagged you', 'See who viewed your profile' bait. Worms social graph pe spread hote — Jaise Koobface.
events.impact: Social media phishing mainstream. Trust graph exploit.
events.lesson: Social proof (friends) = high trust = easy phishing.

events.title: Aza Raskin's Tabnabbing Attack
events.event: Mozilla's Aza Raskin ne Tabnabbing demonstrate kiya — inactive tab ka content change ho jaata, fake 'session expired' page dikhta. Firefox ne patched kiya. Ye bhi attack pattern naya tha.
events.impact: Browser-level phishing awareness aayi. Modern 'tab-jacking' attacks ka base.
events.lesson: Aapke inactive tabs bhi attack surface hain. Use karke close karo.

events.title: APT Attacks Use Spear Phishing
events.event: APT28 (Fancy Bear), APT29 (Cozy Bear), APT1 (China) ne mass espionage me spear phishing use karna shuru kiya. Targets: government, defense, think tanks. RSA SecurID breach (2011) spear phishing se hua — 40M+ tokens compromised.
events.impact: State-sponsored actors ne phishing ko espionage weapon banaya.
events.lesson: Nation-state actors ke liye spear phishing #1 entry vector hai.

events.title: Ransomware via Phishing
events.event: Cryptolocker ransomware phishing attachments se spread hua. Files encrypt + Bitcoin ransom. $3M+ extorted in first months. Bitcoin ne ransomware economically viable banaya.
events.impact: Ransomware-phishing combo dangerous. Healthcare, finance, government target.
events.lesson: Bitcoin ne cybercrime ko monetize karna easy bana diya.

events.title: Evil Twin WiFi at World Cup
events.event: FIFA World Cup ke dauraan attackers ne fake WiFi hotspots setup kiye — 'FIFA_Free_WiFi', 'Stadium_Free'. Hazaaron tourists connect hue. Credentials, cards, social media sab capture.
events.impact: Public WiFi risk mainstream highlight. VPN adoption badhi.
events.lesson: Public WiFi = attacker ka favorite. VPN + HTTPS mandatory.

events.title: Home Depot Data Breach
events.event: Home Depot ke POS system compromise. Vendor email se spear phishing → credentials → lateral movement. 56 million credit cards stolen. $134 million cleanup cost.
events.impact: Supply chain + phishing combo. Retail sector me security investment boost.
events.lesson: Vendor compromise = your compromise. Third-party risk management critical.

events.title: Pretexting $46.7M Loss
events.event: Ubiquiti Networks ke finance team ko fake CEO + lawyer pretexting email aaye. Attacker ne khud ko legal counsel + finance head bola. 4 wire transfers Hong Kong bank me. Total $46.7M. FBI ne $8.5M recover kiye.
events.impact: BEC attacks ka sabse bada documented case. Companies ne wire transfer policy update ki.
events.lesson: Seniority claim bhi verify karo. Out-of-band callback gold standard hai.

events.title: $100M BEC Attack
events.event: Lithuanian hacker Evaldas Rimasauskas ne fake 'Quanta Computer' company banai. Fake invoices, letterheads, tax docs. Google aur Facebook ne total $100M wire kiye (2 saal me). Bank accounts Cyprus, Latvia, Hungary me.
events.impact: BEC ka sabse bada documented case. 2019 me Rimasauskas ne guilty plead kiya — 5 saal jail.
events.lesson: Vendor verification process critical. Wire changes ke liye phone confirmation mandatory.

events.title: WannaCry Ransomware Global Attack
events.event: NSA exploit (EternalBlue) leak hua. WannaCry worm ne 150 countries me 200k+ computers encrypt kiye. UK NHS hospitals affected. Phishing + unpatched SMB = combo. $4-8 billion damage.
events.impact: Global ransomware awareness. Nations ne cyber defense me invest karna shuru kiya.
events.lesson: Patching delay = disaster. Legacy systems (Windows XP) especially targeted.

events.title: Forbes.com Compromise
events.event: Attackers ne Forbes.com ke 'Thought of the Day' feature compromise kiya. Visitors ko fake 'Flash update' dikhaya. US financial industry + defense sector targeted. Drive-by downloads.
events.impact: High-profile media site watering hole attack. Reputation trusted sites ka bhi risk.
events.lesson: Trusted sites bhi compromised ho sakte. Script blockers + browser isolation help.

events.title: BEC Losses Hit $12 Billion
events.event: FBI ne reported: BEC losses $12 billion (2013-2018). Average $120k per incident. Variants: CEO fraud, attorney impersonation, vendor invoice, W-2 theft, data theft. Organizations worldwide affected.
events.impact: BEC became #1 cyber threat for businesses. Insurance companies ne BEC-specific policies shuru ki.
events.lesson: BEC me technology nahi — processes + training critical hain.

events.title: FIDO2 Standard Released
events.event: FIDO Alliance + W3C ne FIDO2 standard release kiya. WebAuthn browser API + CTAP2 device protocol. Passwordless authentication ka foundation. Phishing-proof MFA possible.
events.impact: Passwordless future ka start. Apple, Google, Microsoft ne adopt kiya.
events.lesson: Standards-based solutions industry-wide adoption enable karte.

events.title: Year of Massive Data Breaches
events.event: 2019 me: Capital One (100M records), First American (885M records), Facebook (540M), Zynga (172M), Canva (137M). Phishing + misconfiguration mix. Credential stuffing attacks increased 300%.
events.impact: Data breach fatigue. Users ko password change karna normal ho gaya.
events.lesson: Breach inevitable hai — assume karo aur respond karo. Breach detection + response critical.

events.title: OAuth Consent Phishing Emerges
events.event: Attackers ne fake OAuth apps register kiye (jaise 'Google Docs' extension). Users ne 'Allow' kiya — full mailbox access mil gaya. 2019 me Google Docs phishing viral hua.
events.impact: New attack vector — password nahi chahiye, permission chahiye.
events.lesson: OAuth consent screen padho. Permissions review karo. Third-party apps audit.

events.title: COVID-19 Themed Phishing Surge
events.event: Pandemic ke dauraan phishing 600%+ badhi. 'COVID relief', 'vaccine appointment', 'WHO update', 'work from home policy' — sab themes. Remote work se corporate defense kamzor hui. Attackers ne panic + curiosity exploit kiya.
events.impact: Phishing volumes peak. Remote workforce = bigger attack surface.
events.lesson: Crisis events attackers ke liye opportunity hote hain. Awareness + skepticism essential.

events.title: Twitter 130+ Accounts Hacked
events.event: Teen hackers (17-22 saal) ne Twitter employees ko spear-phish kiya (phone call + fake VPN page). Internal tools access mile. Obama, Musk, Apple, Bill Gates ke accounts se Bitcoin scam tweets. $118k Bitcoin collected. Employees ko target kiya.
events.impact: Social media platforms ki internal security question hui. MFA mandatory hui internal tools pe.
events.lesson: Employees sabse weak link. Social engineering = technical controls bypass.

events.title: SolarWinds Supply Chain Attack
events.event: APT29 (Russian SVR) ne SolarWinds Orion software ke build process compromise kiya. 'SUNBURST' backdoor inject kiya. Automatic updates se 18,000+ organizations affected — US Treasury, DHS, Fortune 500. Attackers 9+ months undetected.
events.impact: Sabse sophisticated supply chain attack. Software build pipeline security critical. SBOM concept.
events.lesson: Trusted software updates bhi verify karo. Zero Trust everywhere.

events.title: Colonial Pipeline Ransomware
events.event: Compromised VPN password (reused) se DarkSide ransomware. 5,500-mile fuel pipeline US East Coast band. 45% fuel supply affected. $4.4M Bitcoin ransom. 6 days disruption. Fuel panic buying.
events.impact: Critical infrastructure ransomware impact. US Executive Order on Cybersecurity.
events.lesson: Password reuse = catastrophic. Critical infrastructure targeted.

events.title: ProxyLogon & ProxyShell Exploits
events.event: Microsoft Exchange Server me 4 zero-day vulnerabilities (ProxyLogon). 250,000+ servers worldwide compromised. HAFNIUM (China) ne backdoors install kiye. Attackers ne emails read + persistence establish.
events.impact: On-prem Exchange installations risky. Cloud migration accelerated.
events.lesson: On-premises systems ko patch karna critical. Emergency patching process zaroori.

events.title: Uber + Cisco MFA Fatigue Attacks
events.event: Uber: contractor ko MFA fatigue attack. 100+ push notifications raat 2 baje. Victim ne 'Approve' daba diya. Internal Slack, HackerOne, dashboards access. Cisco: similar attack, VPN access. Both companies confirmed breach.
events.impact: MFA fatigue mainstream attention. Number matching adoption accelerated.
events.lesson: MFA alone kaafi nahi — number matching + push limits + password monitoring chahiye.

events.title: Lapsus$ Teenage Hacking Group
events.event: Lapsus$ group (teen hackers) ne Microsoft, NVIDIA, Samsung, Ubisoft, Okta, T-Mobile compromise kiye. Social engineering + SIM swap + bribing employees. MFA bypass, source code theft. 2023 me group leader convicted.
events.impact: Teenagers bhi state-level damage kar sakte. Social engineering ki devastating power.
events.lesson: Youth + access to tools + intent = dangerous. Insider threat awareness.

events.title: Reddit Employee Phishing Breach
events.event: Reddit employee ko targeted phishing link (fake intranet page). Employee credentials + 2FA code daala. Attacker internal systems me ghusa — 2022 me 80GB data (source code, internal docs) chori. 2007-2022 ka user data compromised.
events.impact: Even tech-savvy companies vulnerable. Employee training essential.
events.lesson: Technical sophistication ≠ phishing immunity. Awareness ongoing process hai.

events.title: Fake OAuth Apps BEC
events.event: Attackers ne 'Adobe', 'DocuSign' jaise fake OAuth apps banaye. Microsoft/Google environments me deploy. Employees ne 'Allow' kiya. Full mailbox access mila. Password change bhi kaam nahi aaya — refresh token valid tha. Wide campaigns mid-2023.
events.impact: OAuth consent phishing systematic attack bani. Microsoft ne 'verified publisher' introduce kiya.
events.lesson: Password change kaafi nahi — OAuth tokens bhi revoke karo.

events.title: 3CX Desktop App Trojan
events.event: 3CX VoIP software (600,000+ companies) Windows + Mac builds me malware. North Korean APT (Lazarus) ne supply chain compromise. Attackers ne 3CX customers se aage target kiya — crypto companies, BPOs. Two-stage supply chain attack.
events.impact: Enterprise VoIP software compromise. Code signing protection weaknesses.
events.lesson: Build pipeline security critical. Code signing ≠ malware-free.

events.title: MOVEit Transfer Mass Exploitation
events.event: MOVEit Transfer file-sharing software me SQL injection zero-day. Cl0p ransomware group ne mass exploitation. 2,600+ organizations affected, 90M+ individuals' data. Banks, government, healthcare sab hit. Ransom demanded without encryption — pure extortion.
events.impact: File transfer software attack vector. Data theft only (no encryption) new tactic.
events.lesson: Third-party software assessment critical. Data retention = liability.

events.title: US Parking Meter QR Scam
events.event: Multiple US cities (Austin, San Antonio, Houston) me parking meters pe fake QR stickers. Scan karo → fake payment page → card details chori. Hazaaron victims. Similar attacks restaurants, weddings, airports me.
events.impact: QR phishing mainstream. Public places me awareness badhi.
events.lesson: QR code blindly scan mat karo. URL preview dekho.

events.title: Arup Deepfake Video Heist
events.event: Hong Kong engineering firm Arup ke employee ko multi-person deepfake video conference call. 'CFO' + 3 'colleagues' (AI-generated). Urgent wire transfer — confidential deal. Employee ne 15 transactions me $25M transfer kiye. Baad me real CFO ne deny kiya.
events.impact: Pehla documented large-scale AI-deepfake heist. Companies ne video call verification protocol update kiye.
events.lesson: Video call bhi trustworthy nahi. Code word + out-of-band callback mandatory.

events.title: LLM-Powered Phishing Mainstream
events.event: ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini se phishing emails perfect grammar ke saath. Purane 'spelling mistakes' wala tell gone. AI ne translation, personalization, context-awareness perfect ki. Phishing detection accuracy drop hui. Voice cloning mainstream.
events.impact: Traditional detection methods obsoleted. AI-powered defense necessary.
events.lesson: AI ne attack quality step-change kar di. Defense bhi AI se.

events.title: First AI Prompt Worm Demonstrated
events.event: Cornell Tech researchers ne 'Morris II' prompt worm demonstrate kiya. AI assistants (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude) me spread hota — email + messages via prompt injection. Self-replicating. Named after 1988 Morris worm.
events.impact: AI ecosystem me worm attack possible. AI platforms ne prompt sanitization improve ki.
events.lesson: AI agents = new attack surface. Zero trust AI mandatory.

events.title: AI Browser Hijacking Demonstrated
events.event: Researchers ne ChatGPT Operator, Claude Computer Use, Google Mariner ko hijack kiya — malicious page se. AI ne unauthorized purchases, data sharing ki. Production cases abhi nahi par threat imminent. AI agent safety critical research area.
events.impact: AI agents production me aane se pehle safety framework zaroori.
events.lesson: Autonomous AI = approval mode mandatory for sensitive actions.

events.title: Agentic AI Threats Emerge
events.event: Attackers ne AI agents deploy karna shuru kiya — recon, phishing emails, replies, wire fraud. AI-to-AI attacks. Autonomous BEC campaigns. Human attackers sirf oversight. Research me confirmed. Defensive AI SOC mainstream.
events.impact: AI vs AI security era shuru. SOC analyst role change.
events.lesson: AI ko AI se defend karo. Human judgment + strategic oversight.

events.title: Passkeys Industry-Wide Adoption
events.event: Google, Apple, Microsoft, Amazon, PayPal, GitHub, WhatsApp ne passkeys default kiya. 90% major sites passkey-ready. SMS OTP legacy tech ban gayi. FIDO2 + WebAuthn standard worldwide. Phishing fundamentally broken for passkey accounts.
events.impact: Passwordless era mainstream. Phishing effectiveness drop for enabled accounts.
events.lesson: Standards-based defense industry-wide change la sakte.

events.title: Post-Quantum Crypto Adoption
events.event: NIST PQC standards (ML-KEM, ML-DSA, SLH-DSA) mainstream adoption. Banks, governments, browsers hybrid mode me migrate. Chrome, iOS, Signal already PQC-ready. 'Harvest now, decrypt later' concerns board-level. Migration timeline 2026-2030.
events.impact: Quantum-safe crypto migration begins. Legacy RSA/ECC phased out.
events.lesson: Aaj ka encrypted data kal quantum se decrypt ho sakta. Migrate now.

events.title: Prompt Injection #1 LLM Risk
events.event: OWASP LLM Top 10 me prompt injection #1 risk. Enterprise LLM deployments me massive issue. AI email assistants, customer support bots, coding agents sab vulnerable. Indirect prompt injection via emails, webpages, PDFs. Attacks mainstream.
events.impact: Every company jo AI deploy karegi, prompt injection face karegi.
events.lesson: AI inputs ko untrusted maano. Sanitize + isolate + human review.

events.title: Full PQC Migration Deadline
events.event: NSA/CISA recommended deadline for critical systems. Enterprises full PQC migration target. Quantum computers progress — 1000+ logical qubits expected. Cryptographically relevant quantum computer (CRQC) 2030-2035 estimated.
events.impact: Migration complete karna critical. Legacy systems forced upgrade.
events.lesson: Planning + early migration = smooth transition.

events.title: AI-First Security Standard
events.event: Security operations AI-first ho gaye. AI SOC standard, human judgment strategic. Behavioral biometrics, continuous authentication, deepfake detection real-time. AI-vs-AI arms race standard. 'AI Security Engineer' top job role.
events.impact: Security industry transformation complete. Traditional SOC analyst role evolved.
events.lesson: AI ko weapon aur shield dono ki tarah use karo. Human judgment strategic.

events.title: Certified Deepfake Detection
events.event: Regulation ne certified deepfake detection mandatory banaya. Banks, governments, media me standard. Video KYC rearchitected. Multi-modal biometric (face + voice + behavior + device) standard. Continuous authentication mainstream.
events.impact: Deepfake detection industry $5B+. Regulation-driven adoption.
events.lesson: Technology + regulation combo me change aata hai.
